  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  October 26, 2023

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281 on October 26, 2023 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna , Planning Department
  Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Boytrese Osias, Public Works Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Dept.

  Staff Present:  Angela Allen, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on October 12, 2023.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Reginald Laudermill DBA Inglewood Wrapping Arms Around the Community to host a walk-
  Up Resource Fair/Holiday Bazaar Event at 650 E. Manchester Blvd; Private Property, on
  Saturday, November 18, 2023, from 10:00 a.m. -2:00 p.m. and Saturday, December 16,
  2023, from 10:00 a.m. - 2:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Applicant must adhere to IPD / Code Enforcement
  Department recommendations; Applicant to hire a minium of four (4) professional /
  Licensed security guards for the safety of attendees and employees; All Securtiy Guards/
  Event Staff shall wear reflective vests; Applicant shall have water- filled barriers;
  Applicant(s) and responsible person (s) shall allow access to Code Enforcement upon
  request; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end
  of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth
  by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00364662)
 Permits & License Committee  October 26, 2023
Minutes  Page 2 of 3

Item #2:  Juan A. Nuno DBA Northgate Markets to host a Christmas Annual Toy Drive – 2023 Event
  at 10801 S. Prairie Ave., Northgate Market, Private Property, on Thursday, December 14,
  2023, from 2:00 p.m. – 7:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Applicant to hire a minium of four (4) professional /
  Licensed security guards for the safety of attendees , address any crowd control concerns
  and navigate traffic away from the event; Applicant shall have metal and or water barriers;
  Applicant(s) and responsible person (s) shall allow access to Code Enforcement upon
  request;Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end
  of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth
  by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00364735).

 New Business License Request (s):

Item # 3:  Lia Jones DBA LC Venture Group 2 LLC to operate as a Restaurant – Live Entertainment
  at 214 S. La Brea Ave. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Obtain annual approval
  from the Permits and License Committee for events and live entertainment at the site;ALL
  patrons / employees shall have valid identification to be inside and remain as an employee
  or paying customer at the location (Bar area only). Valid ID shall be available upon request
  to any law enforcement or code enforcement officer(s);Applicant shall post NO LOITERING
  / PANHANDLING SIGNS in front / outside of the business as well;The applicant or his / her
  designee are subject to random permit & license / establishment inspections at ANYTIME
  of the day or night, by any police or code enforcement officer(s), including California
  Department of Alcohol Beverage Control Investigators. The purpose of random inspections
  are to ensure that the listed establishment are adhering to the regulations set forth by the
  State of California Alcohol Beverage Control, City of Inglewood / Permits & Licensing
  committee;Adhere to Resolution No. 1836 – SP -2019-005 in its entirety; and Adhere to
  all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage.Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the
  revocation of your business license and any future business license application
  requests.Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00364653)
 Permits & License Committee  October 26, 2023
